items.title: amitshekhariitbhu/ai-system-design
items.summary: AI System Design - Learn how to design AI systems built on LLMs, RAG, and AI Agents step by step.
items.summary_zh: 教程逐步讲解如何基于LLM、RAG和AI Agent构建AI系统
items.why_zh: 掌握LLM+RAG+Agent架构设计，可复用的系统分层思路与实践模板

items.title: Synthesis Through Simulation: Generating Coherent Enterprise Data via Scalable Agent-System Interaction
items.summary: arXiv:2610.10549v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-calling agents have become central to enterprise AI, yet training and evaluating them at scale remains severely constrained due to business and legal restrictions on enterprise systems, data, and database schemas. Tabular data synthesis offers a natural alternative, but its effectiveness is fundamentally limited by structural validity and schema availability, while procedure-based approaches yield the opposite weakness, typically lacking distr
items.summary_zh: 通过可扩展的 Agent‑系统交互模拟生成符合企业 schema 的表格数据，用于训练工具调用 Agent。
items.why_zh: 提供可复用的数据合成方法，解决企业数据受限下的 Agent 训练与评估问题。

items.title: Agent-Controlled Forgetting for Tool-Using Agents: Reversible Context Curation in Practice
items.summary: arXiv:2610.10590v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Tool-using agents repeatedly carry observations whose useful content can be much smaller than their original payload. We study agent-controlled forgetting: the acting model selects previously observed tool results, replaces each with a short note at its original position, and retains the exact original in a recoverable archive. A Python harness exposes batch archival and explicit recovery without task-specific model training, while protecting user
items.summary_zh: 提出 Agent‑可控遗忘机制，用短注释替换工具结果并保存原始内容以便恢复。
items.why_zh: 展示如何在 Agent 中实现可逆的上下文压缩，提升长任务中的信息检索效率。

items.title: I think I found a planet nobody knew existed. I used Claude Code to find it
items.summary_zh: 用户利用 Claude Code 发现一颗此前未知的行星。
items.why_zh: 展示大模型辅助科学发现的实践，可学习如何利用 LLM 进行数据检索与假设生成。

items.title: ruc-datalab/EvoOntology
items.summary: EvoOntology: A Self-Evolving Ontology Layer for Data Agents ⚙️ EvoOntology插件为Claude Code/Codex 建立&进化本体层
items.summary_zh: EvoOntology 为 Claude Code/Codex 提供自演进的本体层，支持数据智能体持续学习。
items.why_zh: 演示如何构建可自我更新的知识图谱，提升 Agent 的领域适配能力。

items.title: undefined-ui/second-brain-os
items.summary: An AI second brain that maintains itself. Full guide, starter vault, agent skills and scripts for a self-organizing knowledge base in Claude Code and Obsidian.
items.summary_zh: 提供自组织知识库的完整指南、启动库、Agent技能与脚本，适用于Claude Code和Obsidian
items.why_zh: 学习构建自我维护的知识库，掌握Agent技能编排与脚本自动化，可迁移到个人或企业知识管理

items.title: Meta and Microsoft take steps to reduce employee usage of Claude AI
items.summary_zh: Meta 与 Microsoft 限制员工使用 Claude AI，以降低数据泄露与合规风险。
items.why_zh: 反映企业对大模型使用的治理需求，可学习合规审计与使用政策制定。

items.title: ant-research/AntOmniEvo
items.summary: An auto-evolution framework that optimizes anything — your 7×24 team of algorithm engineers.
items.summary_zh: AntOmniEvo 提供自进化框架，持续优化算法，像 7×24 的算法工程师团队。
items.why_zh: 演示如何用进化搜索自动改进模型或代码，可迁移到自动化 ML 工程与系统优化。

items.title: How to build great out-of-the-box user experiences with Managed Deep Agents
items.summary: Managed Deep Agents includes a new API for managing reactions for your distributed agents, and a system to dynamically assign emoji responses with your instrument of choice. Learn more.
items.summary_zh: Managed Deep Agents新增管理反应API及动态表情分配系统，提升分布式Agent交互体验
items.why_zh: 了解如何通过托管深度Agent统一管理反应与UI，可复用的交互增强方案

items.title: Managed Deep Agents | Deploying mission critical agents to production
items.summary: Victor Moreira, Product Manager at LangChain, introduces Managed Deep Agents, now in public beta, which bundles the Deep Agents harness with managed LangSmith infrastructure so you can define an agent as a folder of instructions, skills, and tools, test it locally, and deploy it with the mda CLI. Using LangChain's internal go-to-market agent as the example, he walks through the questions that come up in production and how Managed Deep Agents answers them: caller identity across Slack and web sur…
items.summary_zh: Managed Deep Agents公测，将Deep Agents harness与LangSmith基础设施捆绑，支持本地测试及mda CLI部署
items.why_zh: 掌握Agent作为文件夹的定义、本地调试与生产部署流程，可复用的交付链路

items.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
items.summary: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.
items.summary_zh: Oracle 使用 ChatGPT 和 Codex 将招聘、工程、运营等专家知识转化为快速可重复的工作流。
items.why_zh: 展示如何将专家知识封装进 ChatGPT/Codex，构建可复用的自动化工作流，提升工程效率。

items.title: How Oracle Uses ChatGPT Work to Transform Recruitment
items.summary: “We’ve gone from zero to 100, not zero to 60.” Jan Ackerman shares how Oracle built a talent market intelligence tool with ChatGPT Work to transform hiring preparation. Starting with a job description, it researches comparable roles, benchmarks compensation, and assesses talent pools across locations, giving hiring managers consistent data and insights. Read how Oracle is transforming work with ChatGPT Work and Codex: https://openai.com/index/oracle/
items.summary_zh: Oracle利用ChatGPT Work构建人才市场情报工具，从岗位描述出发研究可比岗位、薪酬基准及人才池
items.why_zh: 学会用LLM做岗位匹配、薪酬benchmark和人才池分析，提升招聘数据驱动能力

items.title: Agentic Apps: How Big Companies Are Actually Deploying AI Agents
items.summary: Pretty much every AI agent I've built for myself is one agent I chat with. That's great for my own work, but it's not how companies actually adopt AI a lot of the time. So in this video I go through the lessons I end up teaching every company I work with, and how that takes shape as what Oracle calls agentic apps! Multiple agents working toward one goal, AI only where you need judgment, rules turned into actual code with tests, and a person approving anything that matters. ~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~…
items.summary_zh: 介绍企业如何通过多Agent协作（Agentic Apps）实现目标，仅在需要判断时使用AI，其余采用规则
items.why_zh: 学习混合规则与AI的Agent架构，掌握多Agent目标分解与判断隔离的实践模式

items.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
items.summary: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.
items.summary_zh: LegalOn 通过任务匹配和预算管理，将 Codex 日成本降低 65%，同时保持开发速度。
items.why_zh: 展示成本优化技巧：按任务匹配模型并策略化预算，可在不牺牲速度的前提下降低 LLM 使用费用，适用于工程预算控制。

dups.title: yetone/magpie
dups.summary: Every agent's model. One place. Codex on DeepSeek, Claude Code on Kimi, from the menu bar.
dups.summary_zh: Magpie 提供菜单栏统一入口，集成 DeepSeek 的 Codex 和 Kimi 的 Claude Code，便于快速切换多模型代理。
dups.why_zh: 展示如何构建统一的模型调度入口，帮助工程师快速在不同 LLM 之间切换，提升多模型开发效率。

dups.title: Louis-CFM/coucou
dups.summary: A tiny friend in your Mac's notch and on your iPhone that keeps an eye on your AI coding agents: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, Antigravity and more. Approve from the notch or your Lock Screen.
dups.summary_zh: Coucou 为 Mac 锥齿和 iPhone 提供小部件，实时监控 Claude Code、Codex 等 AI 编码代理，支持从锁屏或刘海批准操作。
dups.why_zh: 展示边侧监控 UI 设计思路，帮助工程师在移动端实时查看并干预 AI 代理行为，提升交互安全性。

dups.title: edenfunf/reelmimic
dups.summary: Show it a video you love. Get a new video in the same style. An AI crew (Claude Code or Codex) plans, builds and reviews it with you.
dups.summary_zh: Reelmimic 让用户提供喜欢视频，AI 团队（Claude Code 或 Codex）负责规划、生成并审查同风格新视频。
dups.why_zh: 展示多模型协作完成创意任务的流程，可学习如何让 LLM 负责规划、生成与评审，提升内容创作自动化能力。

dups.title: Oldcircle/geo-sleuth
dups.summary: An agent skill that finds where a photo was taken — OpenStreetMap geometry, elevation skylines, satellite imagery and street view — and shows its work. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI, OpenCode and GitHub Copilot.
dups.summary_zh: Geo‑Sleuth 是一个代理技能，利用 OpenStreetMap、卫星图像等多源数据定位照片拍摄地点，并展示推理过程，支持多种 LLM。
dups.why_zh: 展示如何结合地理空间数据与 LLM 推理，构建可解释的定位代理，提升多模态信息融合与溯源能力。

dups.title: lemomo-ai/lemo-opuscar
dups.summary: Claude Code skill for short films with no video model: 43 film styles, each a style prompt plus a demo film made entirely in code by Claude Opus 5.5 (incl. OPUSCAR 98). By Lemomo. | Opus5.5 x 43 种影片风格：风格提示词 + 纯代码样片 + 导演与技术指南
dups.summary_zh: Claude Opus 5.5 通过代码生成 43 种电影风格的短片，每种风格附带提示词和代码样片。
dups.why_zh: 展示如何利用大模型生成代码实现创意内容，可学习 Prompt 工程、代码生成及多模态创作的实践。

dups.summary_zh: 提供 LLM 全栈学习路线，涵盖 Prompt、RAG、Agent、微调、部署等内容的中文教程。
dups.why_zh: 系统化学习 LLM 工程技能，掌握从提示到部署的全流程，面试常考点。
